name: smoltrace-ops-benchmark
description: smoltrace-ops-benchmark measures model ability to predict or reconstruct execution traces / operator sequences for small programs or code snippets. It evaluates how well models generate exact operator-level outputs given program inputs or partial traces. The benchmark is intended for automated evaluation of program-tracing and low-level code reasoning capabilities.
reputation: A niche Hugging Face dataset with limited but growing use among code-reasoning researchers.
